# Visual Studio Code

> Visual Studio Code is an open-source, AI-powered code editor with GitHub Copilot integration, extensibility APIs, and cloud development capabilities.

VS Code serves as a comprehensive platform for modern software development, featuring integrated AI assistance through Copilot, extensive customization options, and a robust extension ecosystem. The site provides documentation for core features, API references for extension development, and guides for leveraging AI capabilities through the Language Model and Model Context Protocol (MCP) standards.

## Key Topics

- Visual Studio Code
- GitHub Copilot
- Extension API
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- AI code completion
- Copilot Chat
- Language Model API
- GitHub integration
- Source control
- GitHub Codespaces
- Terminal integration
- Profiles and customization
- Open source
- Cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux)
- Insiders Build

## Getting Started

- [Visual Studio Code - The open source AI code editor](https://code.visualstudio.com): Main homepage showcasing VS Code as AI-powered code editor with GitHub Copilot integration
- [Download Visual Studio Code - Mac, Linux, Windows](https://code.visualstudio.com/Download): Download page for VS Code across Linux, macOS, and Windows platforms
- [Documentation for Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs): Central documentation hub for VS Code, AI agents, Copilot, and extensions
- [Download Visual Studio Code Insiders](https://code.visualstudio.com/insiders): Download daily Insiders Build of VS Code for early adopters

## AI & Copilot Features

- [Chat overview](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/chat/chat-agent-mode): Guide to GitHub Copilot Chat features, surfaces, and effective prompting
- [Inline suggestions from GitHub Copilot in VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/ai-powered-suggestions): Documentation for Copilot inline suggestions and AI code completion
- [AI extensibility in VS Code | Visual Studio Code Extension API](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/copilot-extensibility-overview): Guide to extending AI features via Language Model, Tools, and Chat APIs

## Extension Development & API Reference

- [Extension API | Visual Studio Code Extension API](https://code.visualstudio.com/api): Extension API documentation for creating VS Code extensions and plugins
- [MCP Registry · GitHub](https://code.visualstudio.com/mcp): GitHub MCP Registry for discovering and integrating Model Context Protocol servers

## Configuration & Customization

- [User and workspace settings](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/configure/settings): Guide to configuring VS Code user and workspace settings
- [Profiles in Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/configure/profiles): Managing VS Code profiles for customized development workflows
- [Themes](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/configure/themes): How to customize VS Code color themes and workbench appearance

## Development Tools & Integration

- [Source Control in VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/sourcecontrol/overview): Integrated Git and source control features including GitHub integration
- [GitHub Codespaces](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/remote/codespaces): Guide to using GitHub Codespaces with VS Code for cloud development
- [Terminal Basics](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/terminal/basics): Using VS Code's integrated terminal and shell integration features

## Support & FAQ
